title: Fault injection: SQLite write failure mid-pipeline
description:
Write an integration test that injects a SQLite failure (using a mock storage that fails on the Nth write) into the transit ingestion pipeline. Assert: (1) article is not partially committed (atomicity); (2) IPFS pin is not left orphaned after SQLite failure; (3) the transit daemon continues operating after the failure. Artifact: transit/tests/fault_sqlite_failure.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- No partial state after simulated failure
- IPFS mock verifies pin was rolled back
- Subsequent articles are processed correctly
- Test is deterministic
